column1: # COB oil condensing boiler (verified on a Wolf COB-15
# Everything above is the CHA heat pump set. The rows below are specific to
# the COB and come from zivillian/ism7mqtt
# Read only. All IDs carry the correct leading CRC8 (the boiler checks it).
# Note: TelegramNr 554 (DE2A02) is already defined above as
# "betriebsstunden_verdichter". On a COB the same register is the burner
# operating hours - it is not repeated here because ebusd rejects a second
# message with the same address and ID.
# Bits counted from 0 (proven during a DHW charge
#   bit 1 water pressure OK      bit 3 FLAME          bit 4 E1 input
#   bit 5 flow limit thermostat OK   bit 6 flue gas limit thermostat OK
#   bit 4 boiler circuit pump    bit 5 DHW charging pump
#   bit 6 output A1              bit 7 stratified charging pump
# Observed during a DHW charge: 0x20 (charging pump) -> 0x26 (stage 2
# -> 0xA6 -> 0xA2 (stage 1) -> 0x00. 0x20 at the very start of the charge is
# what proves the bits count from 0 - counted from 1 it would read as "A1".
# 17 DHW pump overrun. Stayed at 15 for a whole charge with operating mode
# "Heizbetrieb" and the boiler circuit pump never came on: DHW priority.
# 16 bit registers. 550/551 and 552/553 are the low and high word of 32 bit
# --- DHW setpoint commanded to the boiler
# Not the user setpoint (that is TelegramNr 19 above / warmwasser_soll in
# config_bm.csv) but what the controller currently asks for: the real
